states.title: US States to Evaluate (or ['ALL'])
states.description: Two-letter US state codes (e.g. ['CA', 'NY', 'TX', 'PA', 'MA']) or ['ALL'] to evaluate all 50 states + DC. Ignored if 'contractors' batch array is provided.

taxYear.title: Tax Year
taxYear.description: Tax year being audited. Federal 1099-NEC threshold jumped from $600 (2025) to $2,000 (2026), while many states kept $600.

paymentAmountUsd.title: Annual Gross Payments (USD)
paymentAmountUsd.description: Total annual contractor compensation in USD. Default $1,250 highlights the 2026 $600–$1,999 Federal-vs-State filing trap.

entityType.title: Contractor Entity Type
entityType.description: Payee tax classification from Form W-9.

paymentMethod.title: Payment Method
paymentMethod.description: Credit card / third-party network payments (1099-K) are exempt from 1099-NEC reporting under IRC § 6050W.

w9Verified.title: Signed Form W-9 / Valid TIN Verified
w9Verified.description: Whether a valid signed Form W-9 with TIN was collected before payment. False triggers mandatory 24% Federal backup withholding and $0.01 threshold filing.

isAttorneyOrLegalServices.title: Attorney or Legal Services Payment
isAttorneyOrLegalServices.description: Payments for legal services are reportable on Form 1099-NEC even when paid to C-Corps or S-Corps.

stateTaxWithheldUsd.title: State Income Tax Already Withheld (USD)
stateTaxWithheldUsd.description: Any state income tax already withheld from the contractor during the year.

contractors.title: Optional Batch Contractor List (JSON)
contractors.description: Optional array of contractor objects for batch vendor auditing: [{contractorId, name, state, paymentAmountUsd, entityType, paymentMethod, w9Verified, isAttorneyOrLegalServices, stateTaxWithheldUsd}].

outputMode.title: Output Mode
outputMode.description: Choose between detailed dataset records or a compact MCP executive compliance summary.
